address: 7 Buzhengya Lane, Wudianshi, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, China Mainland
bio: Since 2018, Antstory has been running this historic three-storey red brick villa. The young local chef reinterprets traditional Fujian recipes with modern techniques. First-timers can pick from ‘10 classics’, like Shima five-spice pork roll and braised yellow croaker with scallion. The chef’s vinegar pork is a new take on the Quanzhou classic – pork marinated in apple cider vinegar, deep fried and served with wafer and macadamia nuts....
